name: Catch Me In Miami
source:
When you arrive in Miami during its '80s crimewave, you meet its most handsome outlaw.

Miami in the 1980's was a place and time unlike any other; a beachfront city whose ocean waves rose almost as high as its crime waves. And when you're whisked away to Magic City in 1984, you may fall for a getaway driver at the very heart of its criminal underworld.

[From [url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/catch-me-in-miami]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你来到犯罪浪潮席卷的八十年代迈阿密时，遇见了这座城市最英俊的不法之徒。

二十世纪八十年代的迈阿密，是独一无二的时空。一座海滨城市，海浪几乎和犯罪浪潮一样汹涌。当你被带到1984年的这座“魔幻之城”时，也许会爱上一个深陷地下犯罪世界、专门驾车接应逃亡的司机。

[译自[url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/catch-me-in-miami]itch.io[/url]]
